errors.description: The defining feature of this option — the squared-off collar tip — was not reproduced. Both collar leaves in the photo terminate in a sharp acute point.
errors.expected: Blueprint (high-zoom on the wearer's-left leaf terminus) shows the edge-stitch running down the leaf's lower edge and TURNING A CORNER into a short straight terminal edge, producing a blunt, near-right-angle squared end. Catalog text is unambiguous: 'squared-off tips', 'blunt square ends'. Locked spec shapes = 'small square', 'square'.
errors.actual: Both leaves converge to an acute, needle-sharp point (~35-40 deg included angle) with the two edges meeting at a single vertex. No terminal edge, no corner, no blunt face anywhere on either leaf.
errors.correction: Append hard emphasis that each collar leaf must END IN A SHORT STRAIGHT SQUARED-OFF EDGE, not a point: the outer front edge and the lower edge of each leaf must be joined by a visible flat terminal edge roughly 8-10 mm long, meeting each adjoining edge at an approximately 90-degree corner, so the leaf reads as CUT OFF / BLUNT / TRUNCATED. State explicitly: NO acute vertex, NO tapering needle point, NO single-point convergence on either leaf. Both leaves squared identically.
